title: THE IRON SHIRT · ONE-ARM TOWER
why: GREEN after a rest day, so it is tower day: one arm at a time, chest, back and arms, a fast quarter mile out of every floor. Legs get one light station after Saturday's heavy laps.

blocks.title: WARM-UP · 6 MIN · ONE PASS
blocks.meta: Moves Method Day A · shoulders / spine / hips

blocks.title: THE IRON SHIRT · 5 FLOORS FOR TIME
blocks.meta: FOR TIME · 5 FLOORS · 7 stations + 1 run leg per floor · cap 30:00 · 52 lb DB, 45, 35
blocks.format: One clock. Each floor: all seven stations in order at that floor's reps, then the run leg. Reps fall every floor. Score = floors finished inside 30:00, then the time. Log time, slowest station and RPE.
blocks.workRest: RUN LEG after station 7, every floor: 0.25 mi flat. Floors 1-2 @ 8.5 · floors 3-4 @ 9.0 · floor 5 @ 9.5.

items.name: 1 · One-arm floor chest press 52 lb · 10/8/6/4/2 per side
items.detail: lying on the floor, 2 counts down, elbow touches, drive up

items.name: 2 · Split-stance one-arm row 52 lb · 10/8/6/4/2 per side
items.detail: free hand on the front knee, pull to the hip, 1-count hold at the top

items.name: 3 · Curtsy lunge 52 lb · 10/8/6/4/2 per side
items.detail: DB held at the chest, back foot steps behind and across

items.name: 4 · One-arm Z press 45 lb · 5/4/3/2/1 per side
items.detail: sit on the floor, legs straight out, no lean back

items.name: 5 · Overhead tricep extension 52 lb · 15/12/9/6/3
items.detail: both hands on the DB, elbows in, full stretch behind the head

items.name: 6 · Uneven push-up · 5/4/3/2/1 per side
items.detail: one hand on the 35 lb bell, one on the floor, chest to the bell hand

items.name: 7 · Russian twist 35 lb · 30/24/18/12/6
items.detail: feet off the floor, bell touches down each side

blocks.noteGreen: Green (today): all 5 floors inside 30:00. Stretch: under 27:00.
blocks.noteYellow: Yellow: 4 floors (start at the 8s), Z press with the 35, run legs at 8.0.

blocks.title: MIDLINE CLOSE · 3 ROUNDS
blocks.meta: 3 ROUNDS · Pallof hold-out + dragon flag negative + weighted dead bug · straight through

items.name: Half-kneeling Pallof hold-out 35 lb ×8/side
items.detail: arms long, 3-count hold, hips do not turn

items.name: Weighted dead bug 35 lb ×10/side
items.detail: bell over the chest, low back stays down
